nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name 'El Salvador'.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'El Salvador'.
Public uint8 state variable holding token decimals (18).
Public uint256 total token supply, set in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) storing token balances of every holder.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing ERC20 allowances.
Constructor: sets name, symbol, decimals and mints the entire _totalSupply to msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using SafeMath and emits Transfer.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and reduces allowed[from][msg.sender] without an explicit allowance check.
SafeMath addition helper performing c = a + b with an overflow require.
SafeMath subtraction helper performing c = a - b with require(b <= a).
SafeMath multiplication helper performing c = a * b with an overflow divide check.
SafeMath division helper performing c = a / b with require(b > 0).
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and event emitter.
Arithmetic operation safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) inside transfer.
Arithmetic operation safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transfer.
Arithmetic operations safeSub(balances[from], tokens) and safeSub of the allowance inside transferFrom.
Arithmetic operation safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transferFrom.
Unchecked unsigned subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply().
transferFrom writes allowed[from][msg.sender] without verifying the spender is authorized, weakening the allowance access-control model.
Address parameter 'spender' received by approve() and allowance().
uint parameter 'tokens' received by approve(), transfer() and transferFrom().
Address parameter 'to' received by transfer() and transferFrom().
Address parameter 'from' received by transferFrom().
Address parameter 'tokenOwner' received by balanceOf() and allowance().
uint parameter 'a' received by the SafeMath helper functions.
uint parameter 'b' received by the SafeMath helper functions.
Local return variable 'c' computed inside the SafeMath helpers.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the string literal 'El Salvador' to name.
Constructor assigns the string literal 'El Salvador' to symbol.
Constructor assigns 18 to decimals.
Constructor assigns the initial supply to _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the whole supply into balances.
Constructor uses msg.sender as the initial token recipient.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply to compute its return value.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] which is subtracted from the supply.
totalSupply performs an unchecked unsigned subtraction.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
balanceOf uses tokenOwner as mapping key.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
allowance uses tokenOwner as the first mapping key.
allowance uses spender as the second mapping key.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve uses the spender parameter as mapping key.
approve stores the tokens parameter as the allowance amount.
transfer performs safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer performs safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transfer updates the balances mapping.
transfer deducts from balances[msg.sender].
transfer credits the 'to' parameter address.
transfer uses the tokens parameter as the amount.
transferFrom performs safeSub on the source balance and on the allowance.
transferFrom performs safeAdd on the destination balance.
transferFrom writes the allowance mapping without checking spender authorization.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom modifies allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key of the allowance mapping.
transferFrom uses the 'from' parameter as the source address.
transferFrom uses the 'to' parameter as the destination address.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter as the amount.
safeAdd reads parameter a.
safeAdd reads parameter b.
safeAdd computes c = a + b, the arithmetic core of the helper.
safeSub reads parameter a.
safeSub reads parameter b.
safeSub computes c = a - b, the arithmetic core of the helper.
safeMul reads parameter a.
safeMul reads parameter b.
safeMul computes c = a * b, the arithmetic core of the helper.
safeDiv reads parameter a.
safeDiv reads parameter b.
safeDiv computes c = a / b, the arithmetic core of the helper.

normalization_plan.reason: The spender parameter only exists to key the allowed mapping written by approve().
The tokens parameter is the amount consumed by transfer()/transferFrom() balance updates.
The to parameter is the recipient address used by transfer().
The from parameter is the source address used by transferFrom().
The tokenOwner parameter is only a lookup key for the balances mapping read by balanceOf().
Parameter a is the first operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Parameter b is the second operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Local variable c is the result of the SafeMath addition and should be folded into the helper.
